parse_args: parse command line arguments for SlowFast video training and testing pipeline
load_config: load and initialize SlowFast config from args and optional config file path
build_parse_args: build an argparse parser that accepts shard_id, num_shards, init_method, cfg files, and opts
test_parse_args: test the parse_args function to verify it returns parsed arguments with defaults
review_load_config: review the load_config function to verify it merges config from file and command line opts
